description: How to mark AI-generated images, video and audio with Kennmarq.com from an app's code: the Vercel AI SDK middleware, the JavaScript and Python SDKs, ComfyUI nodes and the HTTP API, with what each market's AI-labelling laws ask of a call.
rules: Call Kennmarq.com from server code only, with the key in the KENNMARQ_API_KEY environment variable; never put the key in browser or mobile code.
Mark each AI-generated file right after it is generated, before it is stored or shown, and keep only the marked copy; if marking fails, fail the request.

A mark records the model's provider, the app's name and version and the markets it serves (the `provider`, `app_name`, `app_version` and `markets` fields of POST /v1/mark), so it carries what each market's labelling laws ask.
